title: PostgreSQL
description:
PostgreSQL: `generate_series` data, arguments written with `sql_in` / `sql_limit`,
and `pg_stat_activity`. Needs `make it-up` (port 15432). See `:help dbdash-databases`.

query.sql:
SELECT to_char(d, 'MM-DD') AS day, k AS kind,
       (100 + 40 * sin(extract(doy FROM d) / 3.0 + length(k)) + random() * 20)::int AS requests
FROM generate_series(current_date - {{ args.days - 1 }}, current_date, interval '1 day') AS d,
     unnest(ARRAY{{ args.kinds | list }}::text[]) AS k
ORDER BY d, k

show.title: Requests per kind (generate_series)
show.description:
One line per kind (`series_column`) over the last `{{ args.days }}` days, made with
`generate_series` and `unnest`.

show.title: Totals of the chosen kinds (sql_in, sql_limit)
show.description:
{% raw %}`WHERE k IN {{ args.kinds | sql_in }}`{% endraw %} and {% raw %}`LIMIT {{ args.top | sql_limit }}`{% endraw %}: the
filters write the arguments as PostgreSQL literals.

query.sql:
SELECT pid, usename AS user, application_name AS app, state,
       date_trunc('second', now() - backend_start)::text AS connected
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = current_database()
ORDER BY backend_start
